ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Service Installation Script
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects suspicious service installation scripts Note: Unmapped fields: Provider_Name, ImagePath

sequences.query: ((Provider_Name = "Service\ Control\ Manager" AND event_id = 7045) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-c\\ .*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-r\\ .*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*\\ \\-k\\ .*")) AND (ImagePath = RGX(".*cscript.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*mshta.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*powershell.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*pwsh.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*regsvr32.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*rundll32.*") OR ImagePath = RGX(".*wscript.*")))
